summary: NIP Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a planned ADS ratio change from 1 ADS : 2 Class A shares to 1 ADS : 60 Class A shares, effective as of a 1-for-30 reverse ADS split on or about July 6, 2026. No shareholder action is required; Citibank, N.A., as depositary, will automatically exchange every 30 existing ADSs for 1 new ADS. Fractional entitlements will be sold and net cash distributed. The underlying Class A shares are unaffected. The change is intended to increase the ADS trading price on Nasdaq. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation.
